steps.stdout:
Link a project to a Gitea repository.

The project is the one -p, KANEO_PROJECT or the repository's config names,
the same as every other project command. A Gitea access token is a
credential, so it is never a flag value: --token - reads it from stdin,
less the one line ending the pipe adds.

connect and verify may leave --token out when the project already has an
integration on the same instance: the server then uses the stored token.
A token is never sent to a different base URL.

Usage:
  kaneo integration gitea [command]

Available Commands:
  connect     Link the project to a Gitea repository
  get         Show the project's Gitea integration
  import      Import the linked repository's open issues as tasks
  repos       List the repositories the Gitea token can reach
  rm          Unlink the project from its Gitea repository
  update      Change the project's Gitea integration settings
  verify      Check a Gitea instance, token and repository without linking

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for gitea

Global Flags:
      --api-key string     API key; prefer KANEO_API_KEY, since a flag is visible in the process list
      --api-url string     Kaneo base URL (env KANEO_API_URL)
      --human              force human-readable output, even through a pipe
      --jq string          filter JSON output with a jq expression (implies --json)
      --json               force JSON output
  -p, --project string     project id, slug or name (env KANEO_PROJECT)
      --timeout duration   timeout for each request and each --jq evaluation (default 10s)
  -w, --workspace string   workspace id, slug or name (env KANEO_WORKSPACE)

Use "kaneo integration gitea [command] --help" for more information about a command.
